authority: Post-V10 engineering design refinement. This defines a build-and-validation basis, not fabrication release.

plate_model.boundary_condition: Conservative simply-supported square thin-plate pressure screen over the full 165 mm clear span.
plate_model.limitation: Uniform pressure only. Bolt-point loading, seal compression, holes, PEEK creep, thermal gradients and local cartridge loads require final CAD/FEA and loaded inspection.

fastening.assembly: Cross-pattern tightening with spring washers or disc springs; verify the loaded gap rather than relying on torque alone.

edge_control.model: Fit measured net rate to R = J_area*A + J_edge*P using at least the three apertures at identical gap, state and electrical loading.
edge_control.acceptance: At the primary 50 x 50 mm window, the fitted perimeter term plus regression uncertainty must be at most 1.5% of the corrected net signal.

wetted_surface_control.conservative_internal_surface_model: Closed 165 x 165 x 20 mm rectangular plenum before component subtraction.
wetted_surface_control.construction: Structural aluminium outside the gas boundary; removable smooth non-porous metal liner on bulk wetted surfaces. Keep exposed PEEK to the minimum required insulating cartridge land.
wetted_surface_control.surface_finish_and_cleaning: Specify and document liner finish, solvent-compatible cleaning, rinse, dry and humidity preconditioning. Avoid porous anodising, absorbent adhesives and exposed printed polymers in the calibrated gas volume.
wetted_surface_control.validation: Run an impermeable-coupon humidity blank with the fans, pressure compensation and acquisition active. Correct only a stable repeatable blank; reject a drifting blank.

sealing.design: Two continuous EPDM 70 Shore A static face seals separated by a vented and monitored guard groove.
sealing.acceptance: Guard signal and blank-derived leakage correction must each remain within the allocated leakage error; otherwise reject the run.

instrumentation_and_control.measurement_rule: Trim each assembled side into the 500 +/- 5 mL acceptance band, measure its actual volume with no more than 1 mL uncertainty, and use each chamber's measured volume, temperature and pressure in the inventory calculation. Do not infer transferred water from RH alone.
instrumentation_and_control.mixing_rule: Operate matched fans continuously and symmetrically after thermal equilibration; reject intervals that fail the spatial RH criterion.

mandatory_run_sequence: Individual chamber volume calibration after all internals are installed.
Impermeable-coupon wall-storage and thermal blank with fans running.
Three-aperture edge regression at matched conditions.
Randomised ABBA polarity blocks with both sensor locations logged.
Post-run zero-current and impermeable-coupon drift checks.

sources.used_for: Aluminium elastic modulus, density and thermal properties.
Unfilled PEEK modulus and the warning that even low bulk water absorption is large compared with the milligram-scale signal.
Static face-seal squeeze and gland-fill limits.
Typical RH and temperature accuracy and response time; motivates relative calibration and spatial duplication.
